verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a served llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs index at /docs.md. Individual doc pages are published as .md URLs (e.g. /docs/sso.md, /docs/mcp.md), and a machine-readable openapi.json is available. Together these give agents direct, agent-oriented entry points to the documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs well in practice, and evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt-style bundle.
